question: How many tracks are in the database?
What is the name of the longest track?
gold_sql: SELECT Name FROM Track ORDER BY Milliseconds DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many tracks have no composer listed?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track WHERE Composer IS NULL

question: How many different countries do customers come from?
How many albums does Iron Maiden have?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Album al JOIN Artist ar ON al.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId WHERE ar.Name = 'Iron Maiden'

question: What is the average track length in minutes?
Which country has the highest total sales, and how much?
gold_sql: SELECT c.Country, ROUND(SUM(i.Total), 2) FROM Invoice i JOIN Customer c ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY c.Country ORDER BY SUM(i.Total) DESC LIMIT 1

question: What are the top 5 countries by total sales?
gold_sql: SELECT c.Country FROM Invoice i JOIN Customer c ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY c.Country ORDER BY SUM(i.Total) DESC LIMIT 5

question: What were the total sales in 2024?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(Total), 2) FROM Invoice WHERE YEAR(InvoiceDate) = 2024

question: Which artist has the second most tracks?
gold_sql: SELECT ar.Name FROM Artist ar JOIN Album al ON ar.ArtistId = al.ArtistId JOIN Track t ON al.AlbumId = t.AlbumId GROUP BY ar.ArtistId, ar.Name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1

question: How many employees report directly to Nancy Edwards?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Employee e JOIN Employee m ON e.ReportsTo = m.EmployeeId WHERE m.FirstName = 'Nancy' AND m.LastName = 'Edwards'

question: Which genre generates the most revenue?
gold_sql: SELECT g.Name FROM Genre g JOIN Track t ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId JOIN InvoiceLine il ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId GROUP BY g.GenreId, g.Name ORDER BY SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) DESC LIMIT 1

question: What is the most expensive album, by the total price of its tracks?
gold_sql: SELECT al.Title FROM Album al JOIN Track t ON al.AlbumId = t.AlbumId GROUP BY al.AlbumId, al.Title ORDER BY SUM(t.UnitPrice) DESC LIMIT 1
